name: Social Auth Roles
description: Automatically assigns admin-selected roles to Drupal accounts created via Social Auth, without affecting normal registration.
project_description: Social Auth Roles allows administrators to choose, through an interface, which roles are automatically assigned to new users created via the Social Auth suite. It listens for the Social Auth USER_CREATED event and, when a new account is created through a social provider, adds each admin-selected role to that account in addition to the default authenticated user role. Accounts created the ordinary way through Drupal registration are not affected. Configuration lives at /admin/config/social-api/social-auth/roles, where a checkbox list of all site roles (except anonymous and authenticated) lets the administrator pick the set to grant. Example use case: all employees of a company use Google Accounts, Google login is limited to the company domain, and new users created via Google should receive an Employee role automatically. Requires the Social Auth module.
